summary: Iteration 17: full backend + frontend smoke for Super Admin role and email-based forgot-password flow. 10/10 pytest cases green. Frontend chips, forgot dialog, role options, badges, and Settings-no-recovery-card all verified.

integration_issues.issue: voucher88_last_name may not always be written to localStorage: setItem is called AFTER navigate() (LoginPage.js line 47), which can be lost when component unmounts. In smoke test, after clearing cookies and returning to /, the preselected name was empty even though a successful login had just occurred.

action_items: Move localStorage.setItem('voucher88_last_name', name.trim()) to BEFORE navigate() in /app/frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.js so the last-used name is persisted reliably for the quick-name preselect.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.js: localStorage write is after navigate() — race with unmount. Trivial fix, reorder lines.

server.py forgot_password: response body's email_hint reveals OWNER_EMAIL prefix regardless of whether the requested name is a real admin (400 path). Not a bug (400 short-circuits), but consider not returning the hint on error path.
server.py:462 _check_rate: 'reset:<name>' uses default max_attempts=5, matches spec (5 wrong -> 429 on 6th). Verified.
server.py:483 forgot_password filters {role: admin/superadmin}: matches spec — kasir names get 400. Verified.
server.py has grown past 1000 lines; recommend modular split (auth/vouchers/reports).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_admin2, TEST_admin4, TEST_kasir9 via /auth/register; all deleted by test_zzz_final_cleanup. login_attempts collection cleared at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration17.py covers: superadmin login, /auth/names schema, admin/kasir permission matrix (register/delete/reset 403/400/200), forgot-password rate-limit (3/15min), reset-with-code brute-force 429 on 6th wrong, direct-hash simulated success + login + change-password back to 123321, and old endpoints /auth/recover* returning 404/405. Uses tz_aware Motor client for direct DB assertions on reset_code_expires window (8-12min).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only minor UX ordering issue reported for main agent.
